Blade (1998 film)

Blade
Directed byStephen Norrington
Release dateAugust 21, 1998

Blade is a 1998 American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics character.

Plot[edit]

In 1967, a woman in labor is bitten by a vampire and her son is born a dhampir.

Reception

On Rotten Tomatoes, the film holds an approval rating of 58% from 82 reviews.
